summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): rekordbox,Serato DJ Pro.
identityNotes: Research seed; the manufacturer's DDJ-FLX10 Instruction Manual DRI1822D documents USB MIDI control (p. 179) and a 44.1 kHz audio section with 24-bit A/D and D/A converters (p. 175). Converter depth and a nominal audio sampling rate do not establish a complete USB format/rate list or channel counts, which remain unknown. USB IDs, class compliance, exact control maps, hardware/firmware revision, current OS/driver compatibility and physical performance remain unverified; no factory pass tolerances are inferred.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-FLX10; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-FLX10 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Track separation and DMX lighting output
steps: In rekordbox use separated vocal/drum/instrument stems and verify mute/isolation.
Connect a compatible isolated DMX fixture/tester and select rekordbox lighting.
Confirm lighting changes track intended parameters; do not assume DMX is an audio output.
